You are building a billed-probe harness for freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge. You may create/edit ONLY: scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/live_baseline.py, scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/check_live_baseline.py, scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/test_live_baseline.py, and write under bench/results/transcript-1a-dry/. Never edit storygame/, data/, other tests, .plans/, git state or .env. No network, no billed call, no uv: `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp` and use `.venv/bin/python`. Do not git commit.

READ FIRST (match their style): .plans/1a-transcript-continuity/baseline_replay.py (the stubbed replay you are generalizing), .plans/1a-transcript-continuity/baseline-live-prereg.md (the contract), storygame/web_demo.py lines ~244-266 (provider_for/engine_for with FREYTAG_WORLD_CAPTURE=1: the product wiring you must reproduce), storygame/runtime/capture.py (build_capture_provider, WorldCapture), storygame/runtime/jev.py (JevClient), storygame/runtime/engine.py (RuntimeEngine.opening/turn, last_attempt, AttemptBundle), scripts/ringer/stage7/three_c_probe.py and check_three_c_probe.py (house style for probes and checkers).

WHAT live_baseline.py DOES. Replays these eight raw player inputs, in order, against the shipped package data/stories/continuity-initiative: "go in the house", "feel in the gap", "look at the fabric", "pull out the drawer", "feel under the drawer", "go out to the truck", "get in", "look around". For each of N replicates (--replicates, default 5) it bootstraps a FRESH RuntimeState and builds the PRODUCT wiring exactly as web_demo.engine_for does with world capture on: provider = build_capture_provider(state); capture_ask = JevClient.from_environment().ask; provider.semantic_ask = capture_ask; capture = WorldCapture(provider, capture_ask, fixed_refusal=True, engine_refusal=True); engine = RuntimeEngine(state, provider, capture=capture). It calls engine.opening() then engine.turn(command) for each input.
Per turn record (JSON): input; places before/after for kristin, kristin_laptop, memory_card, michelle_drawer, kristin_truck via world_for(package, state.facts).parent(); scene; turn_index; newly fired event ids; selected_knowledge_ids; repr of engine.last_reference_resolution; engine steps taken this turn (find them in engine.last_attempt / the capture record; if a field is not exposed, record null and say so in a `notes` field, do not edit storygame); item_facts_unplaced (provider.last_item_facts_unplaced() if present); every prompt sent this turn (system+user) and the raw provider response text; the composed narration (result.narration, which includes appended delivery text); an `error` string if the turn raised (record it, then continue to the next input; NEVER retry a turn or replace a replicate). Also record the opening narration and places, for each replicate.
Flags: --replicates N, --turns K (use only the first K inputs; for smoke), --out DIR (required), --max-calls C (default 200), --dry-run, --confirm. Live mode (no --dry-run) REFUSES to run without --confirm and without CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL in the environment; never print or write credential values. Dry-run mode must make zero network calls: set CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL to https://worker.example/turn (setdefault) and replace urlopen in storygame.runtime.cloudflare and storygame.runtime.jev with a counting stub; the worker stub answers {"narration": "{\"segments\":[{\"kind\":\"narration\",\"text\":\"The scene continues.\"}],\"selected_knowledge_ids\":[]}"} (copy the shape from tests/test_drawer_avoidance_repro.py) and the /jev stub raises urllib.error.URLError so the client fails closed. Live mode wraps the real urlopen with the same counter. The counter raises a CallCapExceeded BEFORE issuing call number max-calls+1; on it, stop everything, keep partial results, and set summary stopped_reason. Also stop on any response/header containing AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or AI_DAILY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED (stopped_reason = that code). Write out/rows.json after EVERY turn (replicates list with turns so far) so a crash keeps partials, and out/summary.json at the end and on stop: {mode, replicates_requested, replicates_completed, turns_recorded, calls_made, max_calls, stopped_reason, errors, git_sha (git rev-parse HEAD), package_dir, worker_url_host (hostname only), inputs}. Set os.environ FREYTAG_SEMANTIC_REVEAL only if the product wiring needs it; otherwise leave it unset (product default) and record its effective value in summary.

check_live_baseline.py DIR N --mode dry|live: validates DIR/rows.json and summary.json and prints WHY on each failure (non-zero exit): dry requires N replicates, all eight turns each, every turn has the fields above, zero errors, calls_made == 0 network calls to real hosts (summary mode == dry); live requires summary and rows to exist, calls_made <= max_calls, and every recorded turn to have the fields (partial runs are allowed in live mode but the checker must print how many replicates/turns completed and the stopped_reason).

test_live_baseline.py (hermetic, FEW tests, only complete and useful coverage): (1) a dry run with --replicates 1 --turns 2 into a tmp dir writes rows.json and summary.json that the checker accepts in a mode that allows --turns 2 (add a --turns option to the checker for this); (2) --max-calls 1 stops with stopped_reason set and keeps partial rows; (3) live mode without --confirm exits non-zero and makes no urlopen call. Import the script via importlib from its file path or run it as a subprocess (directory names are not importable).

Finish: `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format` then `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check` on the three files; run the tests; run the full dry run: `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/live_baseline.py --dry-run --replicates 2 --out bench/results/transcript-1a-dry` then `.venv/bin/python scripts/ringer/transcript_1a/check_live_baseline.py bench/results/transcript-1a-dry 2 --mode dry`.
